observations.observation: The query requested entity home, but retrieval returned both home and work records and selected Paris from work instead of Berlin.
The query requested entity primary, but retrieval ranked unrelated project records ahead of the primary record and returned Bath instead of Berlin.
The query as of 2026-01-05 returned the later Paris record despite Berlin being valid for the requested date.
The query as of 2026-01-05 returned a record whose valid_from date was 2026-01-10, producing Paris instead of Berlin.
Three identical active historical records were retrieved, increasing context and storage without changing the answer.

hypothesis: Enabling entity and temporal filtering will remove cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested as-of interval, while deduplication can reduce repeated identical facts without changing answers.
predicted_effect: Higher complete-scenario success, especially for entity grounding and historical/future-date cases; fewer distracting records and lower storage for repeated confirmations.
